ideas.pitch: An edge-AI routing system that rebalances urban e-scooters based on real-time computer vision passenger density analysis.
ideas.title: KinetiScale: Edge-AI Micro-Mobility Load Balancer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware-adjacent computer vision with a working live map dashboard, following the winning live demo pattern.

ideas.pitch: A local RAG pipeline that automatically ingests legacy internal documentation and code comments to generate interactive onboarding paths for new software engineers.
ideas.title: OnboardFlow: Institutional Developer Knowledge Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain point every technical judge feels themselves (developer onboarding and knowledge retention).

ideas.pitch: A contactless web-camera vital sign detector using remote photoplethysmography combined with multilingual triage for urgent care centers.
